notes: לְבַדָּם: the לְ was marked unrepresented beside the construct noun בַד holding the whole word alone, which is the outcome rule 30 forbids for a preposition before a construct noun rendered by one English word (לִפְנֵי → before, בְּתוֹךְ → among); the corpus fuses לְ+בַד as alone in 25 units. Preposition and construct noun now share one unit headed on the construct noun; the suffix stays unrepresented under rule 30's suffix sentence.
